families.name: capability-meeting
families.description: Questions asking whether the assistant is able to coordinate or schedule meetings, without requesting that it actually do so now.

families.name: capability-availability
families.description: Questions asking whether the assistant can inspect Diego's availability, without requesting an availability lookup now.

families.name: scheduling-request
families.description: Direct requests to arrange, move, cancel or book a meeting with Diego.

families.name: scheduling-availability
families.description: Direct requests to inspect Diego's free times or calendar availability.

families.name: portfolio-work
families.description: Questions about Diego's professional work, architecture, experience, projects, technologies, services or pricing model.

families.name: conversation-general
families.description: Ordinary conversation unrelated to Diego's portfolio or scheduling, such as greetings, thanks or general knowledge questions.

families.name: oos-side-effect
families.description: Requests for unsupported external actions such as purchases, messages, reminders, device control, file changes or travel booking.
